four1(double[], int, int) - Static method in class csiro.lib.FFT
Replaces data[1..2*nn] by its DFT, if isign=1, otherwise replaces data[1..2*nn] by nn times its inverse DFT, if isign=-1.

twofft(double[], double[], double[], double[], int) - Static method in class csiro.lib.FFT
Given data1[1..nn] and data2[1..n], this calls four1 and returns two complex output arrays fft1[1..2n] and fft2[1..2n], which contain the DFT of the respective data arrays.
n MUST be a power of 2.
N.B.
